dead_ends_in_session.name: The 10x bin mapping bug
dead_ends_in_session.what_happened: initial sim gave random results; debugging for 2 hours revealed the frame/bin ratio was off by 10x
dead_ends_in_session.root_cause: frames were 10ms but bin formula divided by 100*ALIGN_BIN=10 making audio 10x too dense to align with subtitle grid

dead_ends_in_session.name: Off-main-thread player access
dead_ends_in_session.what_happened: every video silently failed to play — no error visible
dead_ends_in_session.root_cause: AudioSyncProcessor called player.currentPosition from audio thread, which throws IllegalStateException in Media3
dead_ends_in_session.fix: replaced with sample-count clock: posMs = startPositionMs + totalFrames*1000/sampleRate

dead_ends_in_session.name: Energy VAD doesn't separate speech from music
dead_ends_in_session.what_happened: score 0.12, margin 0.003, refused to lock on real Growling Tiger audio
dead_ends_in_session.root_cause: Mandarin dialogue over traditional Chinese music produces high energy across the spectrum with no clear onset structure detectable by energy alone
dead_ends_in_session.fix: improved VAD with 3 features (energy + variance + zero-crossing rate) but still insufficient for C-drama — the right tool is ffmpeg silencedetect, which would need to be packaged inside the app
dead_ends_in_session.status: still unresolved in the in-app live processor

dead_ends_in_session.name: 1D offset search inadequate
dead_ends_in_session.what_happened: Pearson correlation of audio vs subs at 60s windows showed random offsets, no consistent offset signal
dead_ends_in_session.root_cause: subs drift over time (1% progressive), so no single constant offset was correct anywhere
dead_ends_in_session.fix: 2D search over both offset and speed factor simultaneously, finding alpha=1.009 beta=-0.13s with 71% match rate

dead_ends_in_session.name: Kotlin 2.4 removed kotlinOptions DSL
dead_ends_in_session.root_cause: Kotlin 2.4 / AGP 9 removed the kotlinOptions DSL

dead_ends_in_session.name: Missing Compose compiler plugin
dead_ends_in_session.what_happened: core:ui module wouldn't build with compose enabled

dead_ends_in_session.name: Media3 has no ExoPlayer.addAudioProcessor
dead_ends_in_session.what_happened: no error but processor wasn't being wired
dead_ends_in_session.fix: override buildAudioSink on NextRenderersFactory (open class) and pass processor via DefaultAudioSink.Builder.setAudioProcessors(arrayOf(processor))

dead_ends_in_session.name: MediaStore.Files query only by name
dead_ends_in_session.what_happened: subs never resolved for C-dramas (video and sub filenames differ completely)
dead_ends_in_session.fix: scan all sub files in video's parent directory with priority chain: exact name match → starts-with → first found

dead_ends_in_session.name: No runtime permission for video
dead_ends_in_session.what_happened: library was always empty even after granting permission
dead_ends_in_session.fix: runtime permission request via ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions + PermissionGate UI
